name: Tulane University
header:
Tulane University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Early December 5, 2026 deadline.
• Duolingo not accepted for PhD if English test required.
• Mahir Bilen Can’s university homepage redirects to his current site, which explicitly reports leave and
full-time industry work since June 2026. Ask the department about future supervision before listing him as an
intended adviser. Practice and visiting faculty in the broader algebra cluster are not automatically PhD
advisers.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor’s must be completed before first graduate semester; current transcript accepted while finishing. GPA
3.0 normally, lower considered holistically. UChicago math route eligible. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Start Slate; read personal statement prompt INSIDE application before drafting. Identify faculty fit, but no
advance adviser required. Optional CV/papers may be sent to Director of PhD Admissions. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No adviser required before submit; identifying at least one faculty research match helpful. [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Slate application; program letter writers upload through unique link. Submit before letters; status portal
available after submission. [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
SSE explicit Fall 2027 math deadline December 5, 2026 and no fee. [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
PhD accepts TOEFL iBT 87(old scale) or IELTS 7.0; Duolingo expressly NOT accepted for PhD (only MS). New
TOEFL conversion not published here. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Accredited U.S. bachelor’s OR≥2 years full-time study at qualifying U.S. institution exempts. UChicago
applicant with two years qualifies even before degree; include transcripts. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; may include scores if already taken. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE not required generally; separate math subject recommendation not stated. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
All admitted PhDs receive full tuition waiver plus stipend and health insurance subsidy; exact yearly 2027
stipend not published in checked math sources. Students pay all fees. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years stipend (TA/RA) for good standing; years 6-7 not guaranteed, depend funding/department needs.
[s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
SSE international applicants eligible; all admitted PhD funding statement does not exclude international
students. Individual offer controls. [s1] [s2]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA work up to 15 hours/week average; first fall Math 7001 training. Full fall/spring tuition and summer waiver if
next-year support scheduled; students pay fees. [s3]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
All admitted math PhDs funded; no ordinary funding essay listed. Special fellowship requirements unverified.
[s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Limited conference travel funding: apply other university sources first; DGS requires
conference/presentation/budget details. [s3]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
$0 for 2027 SSE PhD applications. [s2]

Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
No application fee; waiver not needed. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Tài Huy Hà
Commutative and computational algebra with algebraic geometry: syzygies, ideal powers and containment,
graded families, and Newton-Okounkov bodies. [faculty1] [faculty1a]
Professor; homepage dates chair service through June 2026, although CV still says present. New supervision availability
unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 · Newton-Okounkov body, Rees algebra, and analytic spread of graded families of monomial ideals
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Kalina Mincheva
Tropical algebraic geometry, semirings, toric vector bundles, and representation theory over semifields.
[faculty3] [faculty3a]
Assistant Professor; Fall 2026 teaching listed, availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Geometric classification of primes modulo a (bend) congruence
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Olivia Beckwith
Modular and mock modular forms, Maass forms, and arithmetic of partitions; recent work concerns scarcity of
partition congruences. [faculty5] [faculty5a]
Assistant Professor at Tulane, confirmed by official profile; publication verified through coauthor university repository. Availability
unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Scarcity of partition congruences on semiprime progressions
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Mahir Bilen Can
Algebraic groups and monoids, Schubert and Hessenberg varieties, representation theory, and algebraic
coding theory. [faculty7] [faculty7a]
Tulane Professor ON LEAVE; full-time Senior Quantum Architecture Scientist at Xanadu since June 2026. Do not assume 2027
supervision availability.

Research evidence: 2025 · K-Orbit Closures and Hessenberg Varieties
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
